gloss: secret talk; confidential conversation; whispered story

definitions.gloss: secret talk; confidential conversation; whispered story
definitions.explanation: A conversation or story shared in confidence, not meant for others to hear.

examples.japanese: {秘密話|ひみつばなし}がある。
examples.english: I have a secret to tell.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたちが{秘密話|ひみつばなし}をしている。
{友達|ともだち}に{耳元|みみもと}で{秘密話|ひみつばなし}をしたら、{隣|となり}の{人|ひと}に{聞|き}かれてしまった。
examples.english: When I whispered a secret to my friend, the person next to us overheard.

notes:
A compound of {秘密|ひみつ} (secret) and {話|はなし} (talk/story), with {話|はなし} voiced to ばなし through rendaku. This is an informal, everyday word often associated with children whispering secrets or friends sharing confidential gossip.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秘密話|ひみつばなし}をする: to share a secret; to have a confidential conversation
- {秘密話|ひみつばなし}を{聞|き}く: to hear a secret
- {秘密話|ひみつばなし}がばれる: for a secret to get out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {内緒話|ないしょばなし}: secret talk (very similar; {内緒|ないしょ} is slightly more colloquial)
- {秘密|ひみつ}: secret (the noun by itself, without the conversational nuance)
- {噂話|うわさばなし}: gossip (not necessarily secret)
